posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: After welcoming son Vihaan with Vicky Kaushal, Katrina Kaif is reportedly eyeing her comeback through OTT projects, actively reading scripts for a potential return by 2027.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Imtiaz Ali film with Vedang Raina and Sharvari releases June 12, while he continues to ride high after making history as the first Indian musician to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser has crossed 75 million views in 24 hours, showcasing her fierce transformation as an assassin in the YRF Spy Universe. The film releases July 3.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra ranks #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 list — the only woman on the standalone cover series. She's currently shooting S.S. Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with an ensemble cast including Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan. He publicly praised Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser, rallying the Bollywood fraternity.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is rumored to join Priyanka Chopra and Alia Bhatt in the long-awaited Jee Le Zaraa, while Shah Rukh Khan is said to be in talks for a cameo in the multi-starrer film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor continues to dominate social media as one of India's most-followed celebrities, keeping fans engaged with her lifestyle and fashion content while her next film projects remain under wraps.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh were spotted at their new ₹119-crore Bandra sea-facing mansion next to Mannat. Deepika, pregnant with her second child, is wrapping up filming for King and Raaka.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh received an extortion threat demanding crores, with security beefed up at his Dadar residence. He ranks #5 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 list.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan remains one of Bollywood's most iconic figures, with fans anticipating news about her next on-screen project following her celebrated performance in Ponniyin Selvan.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 trailer with Shahid Kapoor has topped YouTube charts for a week ahead of its June 19 release. She's also reuniting with Vijay Deverakonda for the period drama Rana Baali.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram releases June 19 — a Baasha-style action-comedy she co-produced, where she plays a woman hiding an action-packed past from her in-laws. Runtime: 2 hours 34 minutes.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun ranks #10 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities list. His next mega project with director Atlee (AA22xA6) has been officially announced with behind-the-scenes footage.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi has crossed ₹150 crore net in India within its first four days, hitting #1 in UK & Ireland. The film is nearing the ₹200 crore India gross milestone.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR publicly praised Alia Bhatt's Alpha teaser alongside Shah Rukh Khan and other industry heavyweights, showing strong Tollywood-Bollywood solidarity. Fans eagerly await updates on his next project.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor earned her biggest paycheck of ₹8 crore for Peddi opposite Ram Charan — a 50% jump from Devara. She's next starring in Atlee's Raaka with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's Dharma musical romance Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya is set for release, as she continues building her portfolio with multiple Bollywood projects in the pipeline.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani stars alongside Yash in the postponed mega-budget Toxic, now being repositioned for a global release after an overwhelming CinemaCon reception. She also leads Maddock's Shakti Shalini.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan has signed with Hollywood powerhouse Anonymous Content, marking a major step in his international career ambitions as he explores global projects beyond Bollywood.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai, directed by father David Dhawan, has been rescheduled to June 12 after navigating a box-office clash with Yash's Toxic.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal's All Hearts Tour continues across multiple US cities in 2026. She's also nominated for the Filmfare Best Female Playback Singer award for Saiyaara Reprise.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman launched Rooh Records with son AR Ameen and Warner Music India, while his all-women ensemble Rooh-e-Noor under KM Musiq continues to make waves in the music industry.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay has shaken up Tamil Nadu politics by smashing the DMK-AIADMK binary in the 2026 state elections. His film Jananayagan is now eyeing a July release window.
